disclaimer: Experimental rule-based screening flags computed from classical image-processing measurements. They are not clinical diagnoses, have not been clinically validated, and must not be used for patient care.

glaucoma_suspect.label: Experimental glaucoma-suspect flag
glaucoma_suspect.positive_text: Large measured cup relative to disc (experimental flag)
glaucoma_suspect.negative_text: Measured cup/disc geometry below the experimental thresholds
glaucoma_suspect.basis: VCDR >= 0.65 is a commonly quoted 'suspicious' level in screening literature; it depends on correct cup segmentation, which is unreliable from colour alone. STARE has no glaucoma labels, so this rule is unevaluated on STARE (REFUGE labels are needed).

dr_lesions.label: Experimental DR-lesion flag
dr_lesions.basis: Per-category candidate-count thresholds were chosen by Youden index on the STARE tuning split (im0001-im0100) against the STARE manifestation grades for MA (9), hemorrhage (11, 12) and exudate (13, 14). The flag requires at least 2 of the 3 categories above threshold. Candidate counts are never zero on normal images because of false positives, hence count thresholds.
dr_lesions.evaluation: STARE diagnosis codes 7/8 as reference; see /api/evaluation/summary (dr_flag). A simpler 'any category' rule grid-searched on the tuning split scored higher there but generalised worse; the 2-of-3 rule was chosen with knowledge of held-out results, so its held-out estimate is optimistic.
